Extreme Longevity Index: centenarians per 100,000 births, cohorts 1880–1900, zone vs rest of Sardinia (Poulain et al. 2004, as reported in Poulain, Herm & Pes 2013)
Male death-rate ratio vs the rest of Costa Rica, 1990–2011 (95% CI); no advantage for women (Rosero-Bixby, Dow & Rehkopf 2013)
No birth registers, so the index used in Sardinia cannot be computed; the weakest data of the four (Poulain, Herm & Pes 2013)

Extra life expectancy at age 30 of 34,192 California Adventists followed 1976–1988 (95% CI) (Fraser & Shavlik 2001). A religious cohort, not a territory with validated ages: flagged as non-demographic.
